title: Aligned docs and database view with served corpus
points: Updated the public Database view to describe the live served corpus separately from the ticker-period QC matrix, including Statements, Filings, Announcements, and Macro.
Updated public docs, app copy, README guidance, and the engine spec so table descriptions match the current D1 and source-asset boundaries.
Macro source previews now carry source-document metadata and are grouped by report family: Economic Survey, Budget, and SBP Report.
Removed public external learning links while keeping docs, specs, and generated changelog records repo-owned and auditable.
